title: Final split-emitting computation
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean words $w,s$ with $|s|\le |w|$, running the specified split-emitting machine from its initial configuration on input $w$ with buffer $s$ for $|s|+|w|+3$ steps yields the halted configuration whose input head is at position $|w|$, whose auxiliary head is at position $|s|$, and whose output is the encoding formed by doubling each bit of the prefix of $w$ of length $|s|$, then appending $01$, then appending the suffix of $w$ after that prefix.
